summary: Iter 31 — Full E2E validation of new superadmin restructuring: SaaS Overzicht dashboard, sidebar reorganization (8 entries), sub-page viewMode routing (Bedrijven/OCR/Facturen/Betalingen), Live WYSIWYG Landing Editor with iframe inline edit + autosave + publish/discard, presence tracking (last_seen_at), and admin regression. 8/8 backend tests PASS, all targeted frontend flows PASS.

issues: Goedemorgen (Morning Briefing) modal opens automatically after admin login and intercepts clicks on sidebar items if not dismissed. Test scripts must handle this. Not a bug per-se but UX: consider showing briefing as a side toast or making it auto-dismiss after focus loss.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is 2454 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. SUPER_TABS, SIDEBAR_GROUPS, and the giant tab-switch render block (~lines 2415-2437) should be split into smaller files (e.g. extract sidebar config + renderTabContent into separate modules) to reduce cognitive load and improve maintainability.

LiveLandingEditor postMessage protocol is functional but should validate event.origin === window.location.origin before accepting patches; current implementation trusts any same-window message which is fine for same-origin iframe but defensive coding advised.
Cleanup: old LandingEditor.jsx is still in repo but no longer imported — safe to delete to reduce confusion.

When testing the admin dashboard, ALWAYS dismiss the 'Goedemorgen!' briefing modal first (click 'Begrepen' or close icon) — it blocks pointer events to the sidebar.
